input_length_metric.definition: byte length of the canonical UTF-8 JSON encoding of the canonicalized raw object, with sort_keys=true and separators(',',':')

candidate_generation.discovery: For every unordered pair of constraint nodes, compute a minimum variable-only s-t vertex cut using deterministic node splitting and deterministic polynomial max-flow; choose the canonical minimum record by (cut_size, sorted_cut, source_constraint_index, target_constraint_index).

admission_rule.critical_order: budget check MUST occur before assignment enumeration
admission_rule.branching: enumerate exactly all 2^|S| Boolean assignments only after the budget passes

positive_control.description: OR4([0,1,2,3]) plus EVEN_XOR4([0,1,2,4]) share exactly three variables. Parent size-1 and size-2 separator gates remain OPEN. Canonical minimum variable cut is [0,1,2], k=3, and 8<=L.

negative_controls.description: Two high-arity mixed relations share twenty variables but use only a constant number of explicit tuples; the canonical minimum variable cut has k=20 while 2^20 exceeds canonical explicit input bytes L.

complexity_claim.discovery: Polynomial: O(C^2) deterministic max-flow calls on the node-split incidence graph. The frozen implementation uses Edmonds-Karp, which is polynomial in graph size.
complexity_claim.branching: At most L exact restrictions because admission requires 2^k <= L before enumeration.
complexity_claim.replay: Each branch invokes only previously sealed polynomial explicit-table basis replay or an exact terminal.
complexity_claim.total: Polynomial in canonical explicit input length L under this frozen scope.
